NewsLink.title: NewsLink
NewsLink.description: A personal journalist news link saved by an authenticated BSN News 24 user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this news link.

headline.description: Headline or title of the news article.

url.description: Normalized URL of the news article.

normalizedKey.description: Deterministic deduplication key for offline/cloud synchronization.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the news link was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the news link was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/news_links/{linkId}.description: Private per-user personal news links synced with Gmail authentication.
